items.title: Kubernetes Networking — CNI Architectures, BGP Route Reflectors & Production Outage Analysis
items.description: Comprehensive senior principal engineering deep dive into Kubernetes networking, Linux netns veth pairs, CNI lifecycle, Calico BGP peering vs Route Reflectors, kube-proxy eBPF data planes, ndots:5 CoreDNS storms, and the Reddit Pi Day 314-minute outage postmortem.

items.title: Real-Time Updates
items.description: Patterns for delivering real-time data to clients including WebSockets, Server-Sent Events, long polling, short polling, and push notification architectures.
